## GenomeBrowserProps.trackRenderers property

Overrides or adds track renderers by `kind`<!-- -->. Merged over the built-ins (`feature`<!-- -->, `coverage`<!-- -->, `genemodel`<!-- -->), so a custom kind — or a replacement for a built-in one — is just one more entry.

**Signature:**

```typescript
trackRenderers?: Record<string, TrackRenderer>;
```
